scope: The Intent's requirements, each judged: check-job generated-output freshness covers packages/integrations/pi; the windows job runs the Pi tests; extension and launcher code on Windows calls the bundled CLI through Bun on holyagent.js, not the POSIX sh wrapper; child launches and paths on native Windows, including Pi's powershell tool; a contract test of the Pi RPC or JSON events the integration consumes (agent_settled, tool events, extension_ui_request) against the pinned Pi version using recorded fixtures re-recorded when deps:update moves pi; the pi tests run inside the existing check and windows jobs.

constraints: Work read-only in the worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-prompts, which holds the top of the open 0.3.0 stack (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-review-prompts); read files there, not in /home/user/holyagent, whose checkout is an older detached head.
Judge each requirement against the code, tests, CI workflows and docs as they are, citing path:line; mark each Met, Partly met (say what is missing) or Not met.
Report in under 600 words; put any long listing in a file outside the repository under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path.
